text.p: - Representatives of the Von Moos and Von Roll steel manufacturies declared Sunday that they reached an agreement based on the existing merger treaty in co-operation with banks involved. Von Moos group canceled a merger treaty Friday due to ecological, technical and corperative concerns.
- China's Li Ruihuan, will arrive today for a four day official visit to Switzerland.
- The Swiss government will make a statement today on the planned search for funds belonging to Nazi victims.
- Walter Fust group plans to make a new offer to buy Swiss department store group Jelmoli.
- Authorities on the Bahamas will decided today whether ex-financier Werner Rey will be handed over to Switzerland.
